findings.message: `saveOrder(order)` is not awaited, so the handler returns 201 before the order is persisted. A failed save becomes an unhandled rejection, and the client is told an order exists that may never have been stored.

The express order is created without reference to the signed-in user, so it is not tied to any account. Any unauthenticated caller can create orders, and later ownership checks on this order cannot work.

`req.body` is cast to `Cart` with no validation. A malformed or hostile body passes straight into `orderFromCart`, which can crash the handler or produce a corrupt order (for example, client-supplied prices or quantities).
